# Chart.js 4.4.1

These files are copied unchanged from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/chart.js/-/chart.js-4.4.1.tgz

- `dist/chart.umd.js`
- `dist/chart.umd.js.map`
- `LICENSE.md` (MIT)

The versioned directory is deployed with the other site assets. Load the UMD
bundle before `script.js`, with `defer` on both scripts to preserve execution
order without depending on third-party CDN availability.
